cases.scope: Correctness-only serial E lock and post-E cohort barrier. Native remains uncut; the late arm evaluates real idle reservation. P/D run continuously. The paired tolerance and exact greedy checks use byte-verified E embeddings, distinct from each arm's disagreement with its serial teacher. Batch histograms record the actual independent scheduler geometry.
